title: GLDN Product Research Desk
description: Lower-risk starting words for EcomSniper Product Hunter, informed by reviewed official eBay policy and read-only EcomSniper community research.
disclaimer: These are research starting points, not approved products. Every Product Hunter result must still pass Listing Preflight and final human review.

sourceCoverage.label: Official eBay policy
sourceCoverage.note: Authoritative reviewed baseline. Official evidence may create Review or Block rules.

sourceCoverage.label: Profile 2 EcomSniper Discord
sourceCoverage.note: Community evidence adds manual Review signals only. CE-documentation language is the current actionable product signal.

sourceCoverage.label: Profile 2 EcomSniper Telegram
sourceCoverage.note: The reviewed delivery-date post was not an item-policy signal. Telegram coverage is visible without inventing a rule.

workflow.title: Choose research words
workflow.instruction: Copy selected lower-risk starting words from the Product Research Desk.

workflow.title: Run Product Hunter
workflow.instruction: Paste one word per line into EcomSniper Product Hunter and export the resulting Amazon links.

workflow.title: Run Listing Preflight
workflow.instruction: Paste the Product Hunter Amazon links into Listing Preflight. Bare ASINs or opaque links without product-name evidence remain Needs review.

workflow.title: Continue Ready links only
workflow.instruction: Copy only Ready links into EcomSniper Bulk Poster. Review and Block rows never continue automatically.

workflow.title: Final human review
workflow.instruction: Review the final EcomSniper set before starting any listing work.
